text:
alice: Triage found CVE-2026-189 in openssl embedded in baseimage. Need coordinated rebuild + cosign signing + RBAC window. Low-risk rollout.
bob: Plan: rebuild in staging, sign, attach SBOM, then 1-canary in prod.
chen: RBAC: create RoleBinding in infra-signing for serviceAccount:image-signer scoped to staging only, then timed prod grant. Patch: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: image-signer-staging
  namespace: infra-signing
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: image-signer
  namespace: infra-signing
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: keystore-signer-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
EOF`
alice: Audit retention bumped to 90d for keystore unwraps and image_sign events. Compliance notified.
bob: Storage estimate: ~1.2GB extra for SBOM+sign events for expected rollout. ok by finance?
chen: Yes. Fallback: if signing fails, builders push to staging-unsigned and policy-eval blocks prod promotion. Emergency bypass requires infra ticket + audit.
signing-bot: cosign: signature created baseimage:v2026-03-20 by image-signer key:projects/redwood-kms/keys/signer-main
deploy-bot: canary deployed baseimage:v2026-03-20-canary to pool:canary-2
alice: Add `cosign verify` to smoke: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood-kms/keys/signer-main baseimage:v2026-03-20`
bob: Oncall agreed for 2h window tomorrow 15:00 UTC. I'll watch pager. :thumbsup:
alice: PR for RBAC + alerts + runbook opened: https://git.redwood/infrasec/pull/429 — includes alert (sign_fail > 5/min -> pager) and runbook note.
chen: LGTM. Ready to cutover after staging smoke passes.
